about_the_game:
A Fengshen Bang (Investiture of the Gods) themed Roguelike where players enter dungeons to battle waves of enemies. Players gather resources to strengthen themselves through various systems, enabling them to fight more powerful foes and continuously push their limits!

Gameplay:

  • Players enter a dungeon instance.

  • Enemies spawn every 60 seconds.

  • Each new wave is stronger than the last but drops better resources.

  • If enemies are killed too slowly, they will accumulate, drastically increasing survival pressure!

Game Systems (Named after Fengshen Characters):

  • Guangchengzi (Upgrade System):

    • Consume Talismans and Sycee to light Soul Orbs for breakthroughs.

    • Successfully breaking through increases your character level.

    • The higher your level, the lower the breakthrough success rate.

  • Yuding Zhenren (Mastery System):

    • Learn Five Great Masteries.

    • The only way to gain specific Resistance attributes.

  • Taiyi Zhenren (Ascension System):

    • Consume Talismans, Sycee, and Spiritual Energy to raise your Cultivation Level.

    • Higher Cultivation Levels grant the Lifesteal attribute.

  • Puxian Zhenren (Five Elements System):

    • Enhance your Elemental Levels (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water).

    • Utilize Elemental Strengths/Weaknesses (Generation/Conquest cycles) in combat.

    • Gives significant advantages against enemies based on elemental matchups.

  • Juliusun (Rebirth System):

    • Consume Rebirth Stones to increase your Rebirth Level.

    • Each Rebirth Level grants permanent increases to core attributes (e.g., STR, AGI, INT, VIT).

  • Cihang Daoren (Talent System):

    • Grants core attribute boosts.

    • Awards Talent Points upon leveling.

    • Talent Points can be spent across six distinct Talent Trees.

  • Huanglong Zhenren (Divine Beast/Mount System):

    • Consume Mount Advancement Pills, Talismans, and Spiritual Energy to level up your mount.

    • Leveling unlocks new Divine Beast mounts.

  • Chijingzi (Formation System):

    • Leveling up Formations boosts your attributes.

    • Higher Formation Levels also unlock visually impressive aura effects.

  • Daoxing Tianzun (Forging System):

    • Adds Premium Attributes to individual pieces of equipment.

    • Reaching specific total values of Premium Attributes across equipped gear activates powerful Set Bonuses.

Game Benefits & Welfare:

  • Lingbao Dafashi (New Player Rewards):

    • New players receive daily login rewards for seven consecutive days.

  • Qingxu Daode Zhenjun (Monthly Pass Benefits):

    • Supportive Monthly Pass: Grants daily free rewards to all pass holders.

    • Premium Monthly Pass: Unlocks significantly enhanced daily rewards.
